workload_work_year_days_001.evidence: the work year shall consist of one hundred eighty-four (184) workdays.

workload_workday_length_002.evidence: the duty day shall consist of six and one-half (6 1/2) hours excluding a lunch period.

workload_prep_guarantee_003.evidence: All employees within the bargaining unit shall have within the duty week a minimum amount of time for preparation and planning.

workload_prep_minutes_004.answer: Elementary: 220 min/week; Middle School Block: 450 min/2 weeks; Middle School Non-Block: 225 min/week or 1 class period/day; High School: 1 class period/day or 450 min/2 weeks (block)
workload_prep_minutes_004.evidence: Educators shall have a minimum of two hundred twenty (220) minutes for preparation each week, free from specific duty assignments.

workload_prep_protected_005.evidence: free from specific duty assignments. / Time an educator is required to perform non instructional duties is not considered preparation time.

workload_lunch_duty_free_006.evidence: Each educator shall have a thirty (30) minute, duty free, uninterrupted lunch period exclusive of passing time
